title: Stairs.
officialText:
All enclosed vertical shafts and stairs shall be maintained enclosed at all floors except the uppermost floor
being demolished, and all work on the uppermost floor shall be completed before stair and shaft enclosures on the floor
below are disturbed. All hand rails and banisters shall be left in place until actual demolition of such floor is in progress.
